• We store your Google email and name, the waste you log (name, category, quantity, and time), your weekly reports, and the tips you choose to try.
• Photos are only used to suggest details for an entry. They are never stored.
• Photos and your weekly waste totals are processed by Google\'s Gemini AI to suggest details and pick tips. Your email and name are never sent.
• Nothing is public. There are no rankings and no comparisons with other households.
• You can export or delete all your data at any time in Settings.
I have read this and agree to Menosan storing my data as described.
